title: fix(record-page): an all-empty field group is counted and revealed by Show empty fields
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBTDAJKyXUan6fJCKsZUf5Pv)_

## 维护者速读

- 用户在记录页（侧边预览、手机、宽屏左栏）阅读记录时：所有字段都为空的分组，以前整组消失，「显示 N 个空字段」不计入它，也点不出来；现在它会被计入，点开后整组连同标题出现在原位。没点开前，页面与现在一样紧凑。作者在页面配置里明确设为「全空时隐藏」的分区也一样：不再无条件隐藏，而是让位于读者的「显示空字段」选择。这一点对记录详情块和详情视图里的分区都成立，不只是默认记录页上对象自己声明的分组。
- 为什么做：「记录页空字段统一收进末尾一行」的规则漏掉了全空分组，和已修好的「更多详情」分组是同一个问题。默认记录页上这些分组的隐藏，和作者手写的隐藏在页面上分不开，所以按已定的处理路线，两者都改为「只在读者隐藏空字段时才隐藏」。
- 出错会怎样：最坏情况是读者打开「显示空字段」后，多看到作者原本要隐藏的全空分区；没有记住的显示选择时它照旧隐藏；打印页和编辑模式不变。可直接撤回此提交。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

A `record:details` section's `hideEmpty` now hides an all-empty section **only while the reader hides empty fields**. This is the seat's route on #36593 (claim amendment comment 7118947910, a route call, not a maintainer ruling). The same reading applies to an authored `hideEmpty: true` and to the renderer default (an omitted key), because the default record page writes each declared field group as a `{ group }` reference with no `hideEmpty`, `record:details` fills in `true`, and nothing downstream can tell the two apart.

- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx`: the all-empty hide now also requires the reader not to be showing empty fields (`readerShowsEmpty`: on the field list, the list's 「显示 N 个空字段」 state; elsewhere, the per-object choice a section's own toggle writes). A print page never counts as showing, so paper keeps the hide. On the field list the section's empty fields are reported to the row whether or not `hideEmpty` is on, so N counts them before the press.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`: the `hideEmpty` describe on the `record:details` section entry states the new reading, plus a TSDoc paragraph. The accept set is unchanged: still an optional boolean. `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` is regenerated from it.
- `EmptySectionsFold.tsx` is not changed: the field list's count lives in `DetailSection` (`useReportEmptyFields`).

**What an all-empty group shows before the button is pressed: nothing, not even its heading.** Reason: the page stays as compact as it is today, and the button is the reader's explicit ask. Every all-empty group on the field list already draws nothing until shown (the field-list ruling on #36147, item 4: one row at the end of the field area).

A group with at least one value draws exactly as before. Edit mode is unchanged and draws every field as an input.

Files to read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx`, the `readerShowsEmpty` / `hideAllEmptySection` hunk and the `useReportEmptyFields` line.
2. `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, the `hideEmpty` describe.
3. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailSection.fieldList-36147.test.tsx`, the new `objectstack#36593` describe and the flipped item-5 pin.

## Tests

New pins, as a top-level describe in the existing field-list harness `DetailSection.fieldList-36147.test.tsx`, drawn through `buildDefaultPageSchema`'s `record:details` node, the real renderer and `RecordPageColumns`:
- the default page's declared group (renderer default, firing control: its reference carries no `hideEmpty`) is counted (phone + street + city = 3), draws nothing before the press, draws heading and both fields after it, and leaves again when the row is pressed again;
- an authored `hideEmpty: true` group is counted (3) and drawn by the row the same way;
- CONTROL: a group with a value draws before any press and only its empty field is counted (2).

Pins this route flips on purpose (rewritten to the new reading, the old title kept in a comment above each):
- `DetailSection.fieldList-36147.test.tsx` › "an authored all-empty hide is not the reader’s to undo, and is not counted" → "an all-empty `hideEmpty: true` group is counted, and drawn once the reader shows empty fields".
- `DetailSection.emptyFieldsRemembered-25883.test.tsx` › "a remembered choice does not undo an authored `hideEmpty: true` on an all-empty section" → "a remembered choice reveals an authored `hideEmpty: true` all-empty section, and choosing to hide hides it again" (docblock item 6 rewritten the same way).

Not flipped, still green: `record-details.hideEmptyRetired-7129` (4/4 asserts the hide with no reader choice), `record-details.emptySectionDefault`, `DetailSection.allEmptyFold-13386`, `detailSectionAuthoredHideEmpty-10485`, and `detailSectionPrintEmptyToggle-12717` (print keeps the hide).

Ablation, one run at head 2b334bf1, under the verify lock: `DetailSection.tsx` restored to `origin/main` 4c93f880 (marker `readerShowsEmpty` counted 0 on disk): the two harness files go red, 4 failed / 31 passed (the three new non-control pins plus the two flipped ones fail, the control passes). Restored to `HEAD` (marker count 2, `git diff HEAD` 0 bytes, blob 8c811146 equal to the `HEAD` blob): 35/35 passed. These are relative imports, so no rebuild sits between the edit and the run.

## Acceptance notes

- The strip fallback (a synthesized page whose strip cannot be laid out, `EmptySectionsLine`) is covered only in part: such a group is revealed when the reader expands the empty-sections line (the same per-object choice), but it is not named or counted in that line, because `isFoldableEmptySection` still skips `hideEmpty: true` sections. Changing that would change what the page draws with the toggle off, which this route rules out.
- The `record:details` `inputs` description in `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx`, and `content/docs/ui/components/record.mdx` generated from it, still read "a section whose fields are every one of them empty renders nothing at all". Both are outside this card's file surface; the seat can carry the wording follow-up.

## Verification

Two-minute check: open the default record page of an object whose declared field group is all empty on one record (showcase `client_brief`, group 「Internal Only」 with `internal_notes` and `deal_value` empty), in read mode. The 「显示 N 个空字段」 row counts the two fields; press it and the 「Internal Only」 heading appears with both fields under it. Browser readings before and after, at phone and desktop widths, follow in a PR comment.

- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: needs a full `pnpm build`.
